input.task_prompt:
## Task: Generate fig5_method_comparison

Create a **dual-panel line chart** comparing Full Fine-Tuning vs QLoRA collapse trajectories at 100% synthetic contamination across 5 generations (gen0-gen4).

### Panel Specification

**(a) Perplexity across generations** (left panel)
- Y-axis: Perplexity (use log scale)
- X-axis: Generation (0-4)
- Two lines: Full FT (100%) and QLoRA (100%)
- Annotate gen0→gen1 jump magnitudes: "15.3×" for Full FT, "8.7×" for QLoRA
- Key story: Both show large gen1 jump, then diverge — FT saturates quickly (fast_onset_saturation), QLoRA continues degrading

**(b) HellaSwag across generations** (right panel)
- Y-axis: HellaSwag Accuracy
- X-axis: Generation (0-4)
- Two lines: Full FT (100%) and QLoRA (100%)
- Key story: FT degrades −12.5% overall, QLoRA stays nearly flat (~0.43)
- Show PPL-downstream dissociation: QLoRA PPL explodes but HellaSwag barely changes

### Data

**QLoRA (0.5B, MVP, 100% contamination)** — EXACT per-gen values from recovery_patterns.csv:
```
PPL:       [15.67, 136.90, 394.25, 691.39, 839.20]
HellaSwag: [0.432, 0.432, 0.420, 0.410, 0.430]
```

**Full FT (0.5B, plan003, 100% contamination)** — Registry has gen4 final values + dynamics:
```
gen4 PPL: 326.19
gen4 HellaSwag: 0.372
gen4 stable_rank: 153.87
gen4 spectral_entropy: 0.889
Baseline (0% gen4): PPL=19.23
Onset ratio gen0→gen1: 15.3×
Post-onset ratio gen1→gen4: 1.11×
Pattern: fast_onset_saturation
```

**To get exact Full FT per-gen values**: SSH to cqa1-37219 and read:
```
/root/autodl-tmp/collapse_severity_monitor/analysis/fullft_vs_qlora_plots/comparison_data.json
```

If SSH fails, reconstruct Full FT trajectory:
- gen0 PPL ≈ 19.23 (baseline, same as 0%)
- gen1 PPL ≈ 19.23 × 15.3 = 294.2
- gen2-gen3: linear interpolation between gen1 and gen4 (saturation pattern)
- gen4 PPL = 326.19
- HellaSwag: gen0 ≈ 0.435 (QLoRA 0% baseline), linear degradation to gen4 = 0.372

### Style Requirements

```python
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})
```

- Okabe-Ito colors: Full FT = '#E69F00' (orange), QLoRA = '#0072B2' (blue)
- Figure size: (6.75, 3.4) — 2:1 aspect ratio, fits ACL column width
- Markers: 'o' for data points, solid lines
- Legend in each panel, no overlap with data
- Panel labels: "(a) Perplexity" and "(b) HellaSwag Accuracy" as subplot titles
- Gen1 jump annotations: use annotate arrows or text boxes near the gen0→gen1 segment

### Output

```
/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_4/projects/collapse_severity_monitor/figures/paper/fig5_method_comparison.pdf
/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_4/projects/collapse_severity_monitor/figures/paper/fig5_method_comparison.png
```

Create the output directory if it doesn't exist. Print "Done" when complete.

### Verification

2. The gen1 jump annotations are visible
3. Log scale on panel (a) makes both curves clearly distinguishable

Gram 矩阵满秩是 LLM 正常运作的必要条件\\n      - 秩亏缺意味着语义级信息丢失，标志 collapse 开始\\n      - 随机公式使框架可扩展至大规模模型\\n    vs_ours: >\\n      SIGMA 用输出嵌入的 Gram 矩阵谱，是事后/黑盒方法，不需要模型权重。\\n      我们用训练动态信号（权重频谱熵、stable rank、token entropy），\\n      是训练中实时监控，更早期更细粒度（per-layer）。\\n      SIGMA 不做 per-layer 分析，不跟踪训练过程的动态变化。\\n    threat_level: medium\\n\\n  - # 最后更新: 2026-05-14 (expanded to 37 papers)
# 研究方向: 在线监控模型 collapse 严重度——用训练动态信号实时跟踪迭代合成数据训练中的质量退化

# ============================================================
# 竞争关系分类说明:
#   direct_competitor  — 解决同一问题（在线监控 collapse）
#   related            — 解决相近问题或使用相关方法
#   complementary      — 互补（提供理论基础/工具/缓解策略）
#   foundation         — 领域基础工作
# ============================================================

papers:

  # ===================== DIRECT COMPETITORS =====================

  - id: sigma_2026
    title: "SIGMA: Scalable Spectral Insights for LLM Model Collapse"
    authors: [Yi Gu, Lingyou Pang, Xiangkun Ye, Tianyu Wang, Jianyu Lin, Carey E. Priebe, Alexander Aue]
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv (2601.03385)
    relation: direct_competitor
    core_method: >
      通过 embedding Gram 矩阵的谱分析来量化 model collapse 程度。
      推导 Gram 矩阵谱的确定性和随机性界，用谱收缩作为 collapse 指标。
    signals: [Gram matrix spectrum, rank deficiency, spectral bounds]
    scale: model-level (output embeddings)
    key_findings:
      - Gram 矩阵满秩是 LLM 正常运作的必要条件
      - 秩亏缺意味着语义级信息丢失，标志 collapse 开始
      - 随机公式使框架可扩展至大规模模型
    vs_ours: >
      SIGMA 用输出嵌入的 Gram 矩阵谱，是事后/黑盒方法，不需要模型权重。
      我们用训练动态信号（权重频谱熵、stable rank、token entropy），
      是训练中实时监控，更早期更细粒度（per-layer）。
      SIGMA 不做 per-layer 分析，不跟踪训练过程的动态变化。
    threat_level: medium

  - id: kalinowski_2026
    title: "Monitoring Neural Training with Topology: A Footprint-Predictable Collapse Index"
    authors: [Alexander Kalinowski]
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv (2604.26984)
    relation: direct_competitor
    core_method: >
      提出在线拓扑感知监控器，结合 Modular Morse Homology Maintenance (MMHM)
      和复合 Collapse Index (CI)，通过稀疏增量更新实现快速在线监控。
    signals: [persistent homology, Collapse Index (CI), topological features]
    scale: model-level (representation space topology)
    key_findings:
      - CI 在 LLM fine-tuning 和时序 KGE 训练中提供低延迟早期预警
      - 表征各向异性和多尺度结构丧失在性能指标反应之前就可检测
      - 增量更新避免每个 epoch 重建复形
    vs_ours: >
      Kalinowski 用拓扑信号（persistent homology），我们用频谱/熵信号。
      两者都是在线监控，但信号族完全不同。我们的信号更轻量、
      更可解释（stable rank/spectral entropy 有直接的线性代数含义）。
      Kalinowski 不研究迭代合成数据训练场景。
    threat_level: medium

  # ===================== CLOSELY RELATED =====================

  - id: spectral_lens_2026
    title: "Spectral Lens: Activation and Gradient Spectra as Diagnostics of LLM Optimization"
    authors: [Andy Zeyi Liu et al.]
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv (2605.05683)
    relation: related
    core_method: >
      用 activation covariance 和 per-sample gradient 的 SVD 谱
      作为 LLM 训练优化的诊断工具。
    signals: [activation covariance spectrum, gradient SVD spectrum]
    scale: layer-level
    key_findings:
      - batch size 是表示几何的隐藏决定因素
      - 早期训练的 activation covariance 尾部可预测下游 token 效率
      - activation 谱头部运动 + gradient 谱可区分学习侧和执行侧改进
    vs_ours: >
      方法论高度相关——同样用频谱分析训练动态。
      但他们关注优化诊断，不研究 collapse/合成数据退化。
      可作为方法论参考。
    threat_level: low

  - id: shi_neurips2025
    title: "A Closer Look at Model Collapse: From a Generalization-to-Memorization Perspective"
    authors: [Lianghe Shi, Meng Wu, Huijie Zhang, Zekai Zhang, Molei Tao, Qing Qu]
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025 (Spotlight)
    relation: related
    core_method: >
      揭示 model collapse 中从泛化到记忆的转变。
      发现训练数据熵与模型泛化能力的强线性相关。
      提出基于熵的子集选择方法来减缓 collapse。
    signals: [dataset entropy, generalization metrics]
    scale: model-level (data distribution)
    key_findings:
      - 迭代训练中数据分布熵急剧下降导致泛化能力下降
      - 强线性相关：训练数据集熵与模型泛化能力
      - 熵选择方法有效减缓泛化到记忆转变
    vs_ours: >
      他们用数据级别的熵，我们用模型内部的训练动态信号。
      互补：他们的数据熵可作为我们的外部验证指标。
      他们不做 per-layer 分析，不做在线监控。
    threat_level: low

  - id: wyss_2024
    title: "Learning by Surprise: Surplexity for Mitigating Model Collapse in Generative AI"
    authors: [C. M. Wyss et al.]
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv (2410.12341)
    relation: related
    core_method: >
      用语义网络和 next-token 概率来表征 LLM 中的 model collapse。
      引入 collapsed prediction 概念量化多样性损失。
      分析不同合成 token 比例 (25%/50%/75%) 对 collapse 的影响。
    signals: [next-token probability distribution, semantic network metrics, collapsed prediction ratio]
    scale: token-level (output)
    key_findings:
      - Next-token 概率分布可精确量化多样性损失
      - 合成 token 比例越高，collapse 越严重
      - 跨数据集迁移：在非微调数据集上 collapse 程度不同
    vs_ours: >
      他们用输出级指标（next-token prob），我们用训练动态内部信号。
      他们的 synthetic fraction 实验与我们的实验设计有重叠。
      不同之处：他们是事后分析，我们是训练中在线监控。
    threat_level: low

  - id: xu_2026
    title: "Predicting LLM Compression Degradation from Spectral Statistics"
    authors: [Mingxue Xu]
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv (2604.18085)
    relation: related
    core_method: >
      用 stable rank 和信息密度 (bits/param) 预测 LLM 压缩导致的退化。
      交互项 compression_ratio * stable_rank 是退化的强预测器。
    signals: [stable rank, information density, compression ratio]
    scale: layer-level (attention vs MLP 分开分析)
    key_findings:
      - stable rank 是压缩退化的主要预测因子（Pearson r=0.890 attention, 0.839 MLP）
      - 层类型比压缩方法更重要
      - layer-specific calibration 优于 method-specific tuning
    vs_ours: >
      直接验证 stable rank 作为退化预测信号的有效性。
      虽然场景不同（压缩 vs collapse），但支持我们选用 stable rank 的合理性。
      他们的 per-layer 分析方法可参考。
    threat_level: low

  - id: layer_collapse_diffusion_2026
    title: "Layer Collapse in Diffusion Language Models"
    authors: [Alexander Conzelmann, Albert Catalan-Tatjer, Shiwei Liu]
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv (2605.06366)
    relation: related
    core_method: >
      分析 diffusion language model (LLaDA-8B) 中的 per-layer activation 动态，
      发现少数早期层展现 collapsed activation patterns。
    signals: [activation patterns, super-outlier magnitude]
    scale: layer-level
    key_findings:
      - 几个早期层出现 channel-axis collapse（单一维度主导所有位置）
      - 尽管看似冗余，pruning outlier 导致退化为重复随机 token 循环
      - Diffusion LM 与 autoregressive LM 的 collapse 行为不同
    vs_ours: >
      做了 per-layer collapse 分析，但在 diffusion LM 上。
      方法论参考：per-layer activation 分析方法。
    threat_level: low

  # ===================== FOUNDATION =====================

  - id: alemohammad_iclr2024
    title: "Self-Consuming Generative Models Go MAD"
    authors: [Sina Alemohammad, Josue Casco-Rodriguez, Lorenzo Luzi, Ahmed Imtiaz Humayun, Hossein Babaei, Daniel LeJeune, Ali Siahkoohi, Richard G. Baraniuk]
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2024
    relation: foundation
    core_method: >
      定义三种 autophagous loop（fully synthetic / synthetic augmentation / fresh data），
      证明无足够真实数据时 precision 或 recall 必然下降（MAD 现象）。
    signals: [FID, precision, recall]
    scale: model-level (image generative models)

5	\section{Methodology}
6	\label{sec:method}
7	
8	We design a controlled experimental framework to evaluate how training dynamic signals track model collapse severity under iterative synthetic data contamination.
9	Our protocol varies contamination level and generational depth while monitoring four families of training-time signals.
10	
11	\subsection{Iterative Synthetic Data Protocol}
12	\label{sec:protocol}
13	
14	We simulate iterative model collapse through a multi-generation fine-tuning loop.
15	Let $M_0$ denote a pretrained base model and $\mathcal{D}_\text{real}$ a real-text corpus.
16	At each generation $g \in \{0, 1, \ldots, G{-}1\}$ (with $G=5$), we execute the following steps:
17	
18	\begin{enumerate}
19	    \item \textbf{Fine-tune.} Initialize from $M_0$ with a QLoRA adapter and fine-tune on the current training corpus $\mathcal{D}_g$, yielding adapted model $\tilde{M}_g$.
20	    During training, we collect monitoring signals every 50 optimizer steps via a callback (Section~\ref{sec:signals}).
21	    \item \textbf{Generate.} Sample synthetic text $\mathcal{S}_g$ from $\tilde{M}_g$ by prompting with the first 32 tokens of randomly subsampled chunks from $\mathcal{D}_\text{real}$ and generating up to 480 new tokens with nucleus sampling ($p=0.95$, temperature $\tau=1.0$).
22	    We subsample 1{,}500 of $|\mathcal{D}_\text{real}|$ chunks for generation to keep wall-clock time tractable.
23	    \item \textbf{Mix.} Construct the next-generation corpus $\mathcal{D}_{g+1}$ by replacing a fraction $\alpha \in \{0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0\}$ of real chunks with synthetic chunks from $\mathcal{S}_g$:
24	    \begin{equation}
25	        \mathcal{D}_{g+1} = (1 - \alpha)\,\mathcal{D}_\text{real} \cup \alpha\,\mathcal{S}_g.
26	        \label{eq:mixing}
27	    \end{equation}
28	    The $\alpha=0$ condition serves as a no-contamination baseline.
29	\end{enumerate}
30	
31	\noindent
32	Each generation thus starts from the \emph{same} pretrained weights $M_0$, isolating the effect of data contamination from cumulative weight drift.
33	The collapse pressure enters solely through the training corpus: at generation $g$, the synthetic component was produced by a model trained on data that itself contained synthetic text from generation $g{-}1$.
34	
35	\paragraph{Models.}
36	We use Qwen2.5-0.5B as our primary model (24 transformer layers, 494M parameters).%
37	\footnote{Scale validation on Qwen2.5-1.5B (28 layers, 1.5B parameters) is in progress; preliminary results will be included in the final version.}
38	All experiments use QLoRA~\citep{dettmers2023qlora} with rank $r=16$, scaling factor $\alpha_\text{LoRA}=32$, and dropout $0.05$.
39	Adapters are applied to all linear projections in each transformer layer: \texttt{q\_proj}, \texttt{k\_proj}, \texttt{v\_proj}, \texttt{o\_proj}, \texttt{up\_proj}, \texttt{down\_proj}, and \texttt{gate\_proj}.
40	The base model is quantized to 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) with double quantization.
41	
42	\paragraph{Data.}
43	We use WikiText-2 (\texttt{wikitext-2-raw-v1})~\citep{merity2017pointer}, tokenized and chunked into fixed-length sequences of 512 tokens, yielding 4{,}916 training chunks and a held-out validation set.%
44	\footnote{Cross-domain validation on PubMed abstracts is planned as a secondary axis.}
45	
46	\paragraph{Training configuration.}
47	All fine-tuning runs use the AdamW optimizer with learning rate $2 \times 10^{-4}$, weight decay $0.01$, linear warmup over $5\%$ of steps, and gradient clipping at $\|\cdot\|_2 \leq 1.0$.
48	We train for 5 epochs with per-device batch size 4 and gradient accumulation over 4 steps (effective batch size 16), using \texttt{bf16} mixed precision.
49	Each generation comprises approximately 1{,}540 optimizer steps.

## Task: Rewrite Method Section (§3)

Rewrite the Method section for an EMNLP 2026 (ACL Rolling Review) long paper on training dynamic signals as model collapse severity monitors.

### Instructions

1. **First**: Read the writing style guide at `/home/ubuntu/agent-ml-research/skills/global/latex-paper.skill.md`
2. **Then**: Read the existing method section at `/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_4/projects/collapse_severity_monitor/paper/sections/method.tex`
3. **Rewrite** the file at the same path, preserving the good structure but updating per the spec below.

### Section Outline (word budget: ~1100 words)

**§3.1 Iterative Training Protocol**
- Fine-tune M₀ (pretrained) → M₁ → ... → M_g using synthetic data from M_{g-1}
- Each generation: fine-tune on dataset mixed at fraction α, generate synthetic data, mix for next gen
- Key detail: each generation initializes from SAME pretrained weights M₀ (isolate data effect from weight drift)
- Document: temperature=1.0, top-p=0.95, max_length=480+32, 1500 chunks for generation

**§3.2 Contamination Fractions**
- α ∈ {0%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%}
- 0% = clean baseline (controls for training noise)
- 100% = full replacement (maximum collapse pressure)

**§3.3 Monitoring Signals — 4 families**
Keep the existing mathematical definitions (they're good), but update:
- **(a) Spectral**: stable_rank and spectral_entropy. IMPORTANT: stable_rank ↑ under collapse = energy dispersal (‖W‖²_F grows faster than σ₁²), NOT concentration. Keep the existing footnote distinguishing participation ratio from matrix stable rank.
- **(b) Output**: perplexity and token_entropy. MUST explicitly distinguish training PPL (fit to current batch, potentially contaminated) vs evaluation PPL (held-out clean set). This distinction is critical for the within-gen detection results.
- **(c) Gradient**: gradient_norm. Note non-monotonic behavior under QLoRA.
- **(d) Downstream**: HellaSwag accuracy.

**§3.4 Experimental Configurations — Table 4**
Add a configuration summary table (tab4_config). Configurations:

| ID | Model | Params | Dataset | Domain | Fractions (α) | Seeds | Method | Trainable |
|----|-------|--------|---------|--------|---------------|-------|--------|-----------|
| C1 | Qwen2.5-0.5B | 494M | WikiText-2 | General | {0,0.5,1.0} | 1 | QLoRA r=16 | 0.8% |
| C2 | Qwen2.5-1.5B | 1.5B | WikiText-2 | General | {0,0.1,...,1.0} | 5 | QLoRA r=16 | 0.5% |
| C3 | Qwen2.5-1.5B | 1.5B | PubMed | Biomedical | {0,0.5,1.0} | 3 | QLoRA r=16 | 0.5% |
| C4 | Qwen2.5-0.5B | 494M | WikiText-2 | General | {0,0.5,1.0} | 1 | Full FT | 100% |
| C5 | Qwen2.5-3B | 3B | WikiText-2 | General | {0,0.5,1.0} | 1 | QLoRA r=16 | 0.3% |

Note in text: C1 provides initial signal discovery, C2 is the primary analysis (5-seed statistical power), C3 tests cross-domain, C4 tests method-dependence, C5 provides scale spot-check.

**§3.5 Evaluation Framework**
Update from existing but make cleaner:
- (a) Cross-gen severity: Spearman ρ + bootstrap CI, Cohen's d effect sizes (PRIMARY evidence)
- (b) Within-gen detection: ROC with **clustered bootstrap** (one observation per fraction×seed to avoid inflating AUC from serial generation dependence) — explain WHY clustered bootstrap is necessary
- (c) Method-dependence: paired comparison across QLoRA/Full FT

### Style Constraints

- NO footnotes about "pending" or "in progress" experiments — write definitively
- All signals computed every 50 steps via training callback on held-out validation set
- QLoRA: r=16, α_LoRA=32, dropout 0.05, NF4 quantized base, target all linear projections
- Full FT: same hyperparameters as QLoRA but all parameters trainable, no quantization
- Training: AdamW, lr=2e-4, weight_decay=0.01, 5% warmup, grad clip 1.0, 5 epochs, effective batch 16, bf16
- Use \citep{} for parenthetical citations, \citet{} for textual
- Available citation keys: dettmers2023qlora, hu2022lora, merity2017pointer, zellers2019hellaswag, Shumailov2024, Martin2021, Sanyal2020
- Use \label{sec:method}, \label{sec:protocol}, \label{sec:signals}, \label{sec:evaluation}
- The section header should be \section{Methodology}\label{sec:method}
- Keep equations: eq:mixing, eq:stable_rank, eq:spectral_entropy, eq:token_entropy, eq:perplexity, eq:deviation
